data.name: Arivu
data.gender_notes: Arivu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Tamil word 'arivu' which means 'new beginning'. It is a name that signifies the start of something new and fresh. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of the god Arya who is considered the embodiment of truth and honesty. The name Arivu carries the meaning “New Beginning” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tamil tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arivu usually hope their child will grow to embody new beginning and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the beginning of a spiritual journey towards truth and self-realization.
data.etymology: Arivu belongs to the Tamil linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “New Beginning.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arivu total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
